description_en: Stops a local recording upload task
description_zh: 调用该接口停止本地录像上传任务
name: DeleteLocalFileUploadJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value is available for the public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the local recording upload task, which is generated by https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/363002.html
parameters.help_zh: 本地录像上传任务ID，由创建本地录像上传任务https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/363002.html生成
parameters.name: job_id
